messages:
ops-bot: Alert: unusual tail-latency increase detected in hosted eu-west-2 for medium/large chat models. Starting investigation. https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-3223456789 :rotating_light:

megan: Oncall here. Looking at scheduler and kernel metrics. Early signs: CPU steal and increased preemption events on some inference nodes.

irfan: Support seeing customer reports of slow responses and a few timed retries. Drafting a short public line: 'We're aware of increased latency in EU-West, mitigation in progress.'

sre: Spotted a config drift in the host agent that bumped the scheduler quantum. Rolling a config rollback to a small canary now (5% hosts).

ops-bot: Canary rollback applied @3223456798. Canary hosts show ~40% tail reduction.

megan: Good signal. Rolling to 40% now. If we see continued improvement we'll expand. ETA for broad mitigation 30-45m.

irfan: Posted status update and informed top-5 affected customers. Will update tickets with ETA.

incident-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-3223456789  Mitigation: agent config rollback and monitoring.

sre: Continuing rollout. I'll post another update after the 40% wave completes.
